tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: List every dashboard card this credential's tenant has published, as stored. Use it to discover the ids already in use before publishing, and to read back what a widget shows.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Read one published card by its stable id. Returns `{ card }`, the same envelope every other read on this API uses.

tools.name: upsert_card
tools.description: Create or replace one dashboard card, for standing state the operator checks on — a balance, a queue depth, today's total. For work with a start and an end that you will report on while it runs, start_live_activity is the better surface: it reaches the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, where a card on

tools.name: upsert_cards_batch
tools.description: Create or replace up to 32 cards in one call. Always prefer this over repeated upsert_card when one snapshot produces several related cards: it makes a single widget-reload decision instead of burning WidgetKit's daily reload budget once per card. Set `replacePrefix` to your own id namespace and the

tools.name: delete_card
tools.description: Remove a published card. Widgets showing it stop showing it.

tools.name: list_live_activities
tools.description: The Live Activities this tenant currently has running, with their content state. Pass includeEnded to also get the ones that finished in the last day — which is how to check whether an end actually landed, or to find an activity whose externalActivityId you lost.

tools.name: start_live_activity
tools.description: Start a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Use this for work with a start and an end that you will report on while it runs — a build, a deploy, a test or capture run, a batch job, a wash cycle, a charge, a delivery. It is the right surface whenever the operator wants to watch progr

tools.name: update_live_activity
tools.description: Push new content state to a running Live Activity. A new `title` is stored and returned by list_live_activities but the Lock Screen keeps the original — it is frozen at start.

tools.name: end_live_activity
tools.description: End a running Live Activity with a final frame. Always end what you start. This cannot be undone: an ended activity cannot be resumed, only replaced by starting a new one, which the user sees as the old one dismissing and a new one animating in.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Every published card and every running Live Activity in one call. Prefer it over list_cards plus list_live_activities when you want the whole picture — it is one request instead of two and the two halves are read together.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Whether anything will actually see what you publish, what this credential may do, how much rate budget is left, and what this deployment has enabled. Worth one call before publishing for the first time: if `delivery.canPushWidgets` is false, nothing you publish will be seen by anyone, and the operat

tools.name: get_integration_guide
tools.description: The rules no argument schema can carry: which template fits which shape of data, what a Live Activity freezes at start, and what publishing etiquette costs you if you ignore it. Read it before publishing for the first time. ALWAYS pass `section`: pick `cards` or `live-activities` for the surface you

tools.name: render_card
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see or inspect one specific 00Widget card. It reads the current card by stable id and opens a read-only visual preview. Prefer this over render_dashboard when a single card answers the request.

tools.name: render_activity
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see or inspect one specific running 00Widget Live Activity. Pass the externalActivityId returned by list_live_activities. Ended activities are not available here. Prefer this over render_dashboard when one running activity answers the request.

tools.name: render_dashboard
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants the whole 00Widget dashboard or needs to compare several cards and running Live Activities. For one known card, prefer render_card.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_integration_guide" stacks urgency/override words (always, ignore). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: The rules no argument schema can carry: which template fits which shape of data, what a Live Activity freezes at start, and what publishing etiquette costs you …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_status · Private data: list_cards, get_status · Public sink: upsert_card, get_status · Destructive: upsert_card, delete_card, start_live_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_status · Private data: list_cards, get_status · Public sink: upsert_card, get_status · Destructive: upsert_card, delete_card, start_live_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
